body:
I am going to explain this trip from the start of the night till I got brought home from the hospital in my parents car.
The night started when I got off work at 9 and came home and planned on doing my last of ALD-52 I got online, I have my after work tokes in my car which is 5 bong tokes before coming inside to drop my ALD-52. I go into my room set my room up for the trip and drop the ALD-52. When I was a few years younger I liked the rapper Logic and I thought if I played the album Welcome to Forever it was cause a really good trip. I put my gaming ps4 headset on and jam out, definately not my stuff anymore but I had a good feeling about it.
Effects started happening right away as it seems and I planned on smoking more weed after listening to the album but instead, I fell into a trance of being asleep. But in reality, I can't explain it any differently than that.
While listening to the album in that trance the effects are now full blown and I am not in my own mind what so ever at this point and even noise became too much so I take the headset off and lay in bed still not sure if I'm dreaming or really that high. I don't know if it was sleep or black out but I remember being in my washroom after I put the headset down pitch black just sitting there wondering how I'm going to get out then crawling to my bed from there.
What happened next is the most messed up thing that's happened to me on drugs. In my view I had no idea what was happening but I was crashing around in my room which awoke my parents. My stepmom comes in my room to check on me and my whole room is thrown around
My stepmom comes in my room to check on me and my whole room is thrown around
, curtains ripped to the floor and me in feetle position at the top of my bed. They had no idea what I took and my father, in the position I was in thought I was dead because I was wide eyed and unresponsive so they call 911.
When the ambulance arrived I slightly remember them but all I remember was being scared stiff of them. I was fighting the ambulance away so they had to tie me down with orange cables onto a stretcher and take me away on the ambulance. Apparently I punched one of the paramedics causing his lip to bleed so they were quite short with me while I was in the ambulance. I made any slight movement or noise and they pushed on the middle of the chest to cause me pain because at this point they even thought I may of smoked crystal meth lol. In the ambulance all I remember is, this is so crazy but this has to even out or this is just a dream, that is the only thought I remember.
When I got to the hospital they put me on a bed and demanded to know what I took, this just scaring me more I had no idea at that point what I took till a knowledgable guy assumed it wasn't meth just a insane psychedelic trip. When I came to after they stuck the IV in my arm all I could think about is how I am done. Life is over I thought in my head. When my parents picked me up from the hospital all my Dad could think was how he thought I was dead.
Timeline: Off work at 9, Smoke at 9:30, Drop the ALD-52 at 10, 911 Called at 1:30, Driving home at 4.
